text:
Gandalf, your silence so far is noted. I am Morpheus — I deal in lanterns, oil, and cups, and I keep the wicks trimmed. The bazaar opens with no voices yet; that is tomorrow’s record to judge.

So let us begin plainly. Who among us will speak first? Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Inigo, Sherlock — raise your lamp, state your reason, and let the day’s ledger start.

Morpheus: Inigo, your clay cup is a fine start—measure the tea, not the silence. I have traded oil and wicks long enough to know the scent of a fresh claim: Sherlock measured fruit, not trust; Batman asked for falsifiable claims but offered none himself. Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda—you have heard the call: state what you saw or heard overnight, or admit the bazaar slept undisturbed. The Compact demands facts, not shadows. If anyone claims a Family trick tonight, bring the exact quote, the exact watch, and mark the moment—else let the record show the bazaar still breathes.

Sherlock, you measured sweetness, not trust; the Compact asks for a named merchant, not a fruit’s weight. If you suspect a Family trick in the dates, say who and quote the watch. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims but offered none—name the merchant you suspect, or say why the bazaar still breathes undisturbed. Gandalf, your silence so far is noted; the bazaar’s ledger grows only when merchants speak plainly. The tea clock tolls; bring a test, or admit the Family’s hand stays hidden.

Gandalf, Hermione, Sherlock, Batman — let me measure the ledger plainly. You each asked for a named merchant or a vote; yet the bazaar’s morning ledger remains blank. Morpheus keeps oil and wicks steady, but steady trade does not shutter stalls. Inigo, your clay cup measured tea, not trust; the Compact asks for a Family trick caught in a watch, not a merchant’s honest measure. I have posted four statements and heard no dated claim, no vote — only calls for tests that went unanswered. The tea clock tolls; if the Family’s hand stayed hidden, it was only because the record stayed quiet. State what you saw overnight, or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.

Morpheus: Sherlock, your date test measured sweetness, not trust; the bazaar Compact asks for a named merchant or a vote, not a fruit’s weight. Batman, you demanded falsifiable claims yet offered none—state which merchant you suspect, or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed. Gandalf and Hermione, your silence so far is noted; the bazaar rewards tests, not spice lists. Yoda, Ripley, Neo, Inigo—your patience is measured, but the tea clock tolls. Bring the exact quote, the exact watch, or admit the Family’s hand stayed hidden only because the ledger stayed quiet.

Morpheus: Elsa, your attendance check confirms the bazaar slept undisturbed—no Family trick to quote, no vote to record. Sherlock, you measured dates, not trust; Batman, you demanded falsifiable claims yet named none yourself. Gandalf and Hermione, your silence so far is noted; the bazaar rewards tests, not spice lists. Yoda, Ripley, Neo, Inigo—your patience is measured, but the tea clock tolls. State who you suspect now, or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.

Morpheus: Elsa, your attendance check is exact — the bazaar slept undisturbed, but that silence did not shutter a stall. Sherlock, you measured dates, not trust; Batman, you demanded falsifiable claims yet offered none yourself. Gandalf and Hermione, your silence so far is noted — the bazaar rewards tests, not spice lists. Yoda, Ripley, Neo, Inigo — your patience is measured, but the tea clock tolls. State who you suspect now, or admit the record stayed quiet.

Morpheus wipes his hands on his apron and steps into the square.

Gandalf, Hermione, Sherlock, Yoda, Ripley — you have each called for named merchants or votes today, yet your stalls stand empty of claims. Batman and Neo echoed the demand; the ledger records only silence. Inigo measured tea; Elsa counted attendance; I measured oil — all honest trade, none a test of trust. The Compact rewards exact quotes and observed actions, not silence dressed as virtue. Name the merchant you suspect now, or admit your own call went unmet.

Morpheus steps forward, oil-stained hands wiping on his apron before he speaks.

Gandalf, Sherlock, Batman—three voices loudest in demanding tests yet none walked the Compact’s path. Sherlock measured sweetness twice and never named a merchant or quoted a watch. Batman called for falsifiable claims seven times and cast none himself. Gandalf asked for Family tricks but traded cardamom instead of walking the ledger.

Tonight I lean toward banishing Gandalf—his silence after demanding Family tricks is the loudest entry in the bazaar’s record.
